name: Insisting on Objective Criteria
scenario: Commercial real estate lease renewal wherein the institutional landlord demands an arbitrary 25% rent escalation during a volatile inflationary cycle.
script: "We want to ensure your commercial yield reflects true market dynamics rather than arbitrary projections. Let us align on an objective benchmark: we will pull closed transaction data from CoStar for Class-A commercial properties within a half-mile radius over the preceding ninety days and calculate the true weighted-average square-foot rate."
defense: Dispute the index's method: it counts waterfront properties unlike ours; ask for a normalized comparable dataset.
originFull: Normative Social Influence and Social Comparison Theory demonstrate that negotiators resist subjective positional pressure to preserve autonomy, yet readily yield to external, verifiable, and legitimate benchmarks perceived as impartial.
defenseFull: When an opponent cherry-picks self-serving indices, dispute the standard's methodology: "That aggregate index includes prime waterfront developments that do not match our building's utility classification. Let us utilize a normalized dataset that filters strictly for comparable floor plates and tenant improvement allowances."
